lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs extending posteriorly from the gill region. The centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with the highest-intensity maxima clustered in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes at the intersection points, particularly visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal aspect to lower-luminance shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6 to 8 distinct, irregularly shaped high-luminance blobs concentrated mainly in the anterior and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of smaller, high-intensity pixel clusters, with a higher frequency of occurrence towards the distal margin compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
